description: Emperor Time's thumb chain — restoration. Router for four aspects: triage (stop digging, snapshot, bracket the breakage), reproduce-and-bisect (make it fail on demand, isolate the cause one hypothesis at a time), heal-and-verify (minimal fix, root-cause proof, postmortem line), and process healing (recovering a derailed loop, skipped gates, bad merges from enlisted agents, delivered breaches). Engage when something breaks — a regression, a red build, corrupted state, or the process itself. Load one aspect file at a time per the Invocation Ritual.
